tiles.title: Articles per month
tiles.sql: SELECT substr(publishedDate,1,7) AS x, COUNT(*) AS y FROM article GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

tiles.title: Sentiment by month
tiles.sql: SELECT substr(publishedDate,1,7) AS x, toneSentiment AS s, COUNT(*) AS y FROM article WHERE toneSentiment IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

tiles.title: Top 10 outlets
tiles.sql: SELECT json_each.value AS x, COUNT(*) AS y FROM article, json_each(article."outlets") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY y DESC LIMIT 10

tiles.title: Category breakdown
tiles.sql: WITH CategoryRanks AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS r FROM article GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN r <= 5 THEN category ELSE 'Others' END AS x, SUM(count) AS y FROM CategoryRanks GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY y DESC

tiles.title: Top 5 countries by article count
tiles.sql: SELECT json_each.value AS x, COUNT(*) AS y FROM article, json_each(article."countries") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY y DESC LIMIT 5

tiles.title: Article Count by Outlet Media Category
tiles.nl_query: article count by outlet media category
tiles.sql: SELECT o.mediaCategory AS x, COUNT(a.articleId) AS y FROM article AS a, json_each(a.outlets) AS j JOIN outlet AS o ON o.outletId = j.value GROUP BY x ORDER BY y DESC

tiles.title: Top 10 Topics
tiles.sql: SELECT topic AS x, COUNT(*) AS y FROM article GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
